newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian tin, nickel extend falls, copper unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian tin, nickel extend falls, copper unchanged.

text.p: India tin and nickel prices on Friday extended losses while copper was unchanged, dealers said.
Tin and nickel fell on the back of fresh losses in the world market which triggered offerings by local stockists. Industrial demand was at a low ebb.
Tin lost 100 rupees at 29,000 rupees per quintal after easing by 100 rupees on Thursday, while nickel lost 200 rupees at 33,800 rupees per quintal after easing by 100 rupees on Thursday.
Copper was unchanged at 13,650 rupees per quintal amid scattered supplies while physial demand remained dull. Copper was down by 50 rupees on Thursday.
Aluminium was quoted at the previous level of 7,700 rupees per quintal, zinc at 8,100 rupees and lead at 4,100 rupees per quintal.
